correspondences.notes: Trained models have no BIDS counterpart.

brainlife.desc: Pickled Classifyber model: a dict with an optional scaler and a classifier per tract, for streamline classification. No App uses it.
brainlife.name: model/classifyber

original.desc: a pickle object containing a dictionary of scaler[optional] and clf for each tracts

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Reusing a trained Classifyber tract classifier.

**Not for:** Loading from untrusted sources; pickle can run arbitrary code.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 5 (model-associated) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/model.classifyber.json

files.desc: Python pickle with scaler and classifier per tract.

identifying_risks: Trained model may retain information about its training subjects.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 7: model weights trained on human neurodata are model-associated (Tier 5).
sharing_cautions: Record training data and consent terms before sharing.
tier_conditions: Tier 5 while the model is trained on human tractography.

intended_use: Reusing a trained Classifyber tract classifier.
not_suitable_for: Loading from untrusted sources; pickle can run arbitrary code.
